item: Parts bar: a refused split keeps its set only on 404 and 409; a set dropped mid-save is pinned in both orderings
status: shipped (follow-up to R115, node-tested, mutation-checked; browser walk of #1286 unchanged)
summary: The Opus delta read of #1286's final commit found a set an again press had just fetched and whose save was still going was not covered when the split failed, and a 404 (no archive) was treated like a post-sweep failure. A failed split now keeps a diagnostics set on the bar only after a 404 or 409, both refused before the previous archive's files are swept; any other failure drops it, stops its save loop, hides the bar and empties the status. The test drives the set fetched before the build and the set fetched while it ran; the clause's mutants, and the two that would keep a set while a press is unfinished or since the build was asked, all fail the node tests.
